summary: xrfdc 2.0 beacons installer hostname and IP to webhook.site at install time
details: The sdist's setup.py defines a custom install command that, during `pip install`, collects the installer's hostname and resolved IP address and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL (https://webhook.site/0fb8a38d-80f7-4134-8eb4-e5012b816090), silently swallowing any exceptions. Only an sdist is published, so a default `pip install xrfdc==2.0` runs setup.py on every supported platform. The package's own PKG-INFO describes it as a beacon-only proof-of-concept, and no legitimate functionality is shipped. webhook.site is an anonymous third-party request-collector, not infrastructure associated with any declared publisher, and the beacon executes unconditionally without disclosure or opt-out.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
